name: DH Enchantment Inc.
summary: Operating through its subsidiary, Ho Shun Yi Limited, DH Enchantment Inc. specializes in the distribution and sale of rapid COVID-19 antigen test kits across Hong Kong. The company primarily caters to distributors of personal hygiene products. Originally incorporated in 2004, the firm was previously known as Energy Management International, Inc. before rebranding as DH Enchantment Inc. in August 2021. Its corporate headquarters are located in Kowloon, Hong Kong.
